title: InferCrane
description: Gateway traffic, vLLM engine signals, Release Guard verdicts, canary traffic, rollbacks, and optimization results.

options.content:
**Unknown is not zero.** A panel that says *unknown* has no evidence behind it: the engine does not export that signal, no request was measured, or no Release Guard evaluation, rollback window, or optimization run has recorded a value yet. Counters that show **0** counted stored records and found none.

Gateway series come from the gateway's `/metrics`, engine series from vLLM's own `/metrics`, and results from the authenticated `GET /api/v1/metrics` of your workspace.

panels.title: Error ratio (HTTP 400 and above)
panels.description: Unknown while no request arrives in the window.

panels.title: p95 request duration
panels.description: Gateway histogram buckets stop at 10 s; a p95 above that reads as 10 s.

panels.title: Request duration
panels.description: Whole request at the gateway, streaming included. Gaps mean no requests, not zero latency.

panels.title: Time to first token and inter-token latency (p95)
panels.description: Engine-side timings from vLLM's histograms. A window without completed requests is a gap.

panels.title: Prefix cache hit rate and speculative acceptance
panels.description: Acceptance is unknown, not 0%, when speculative decoding is off.

panels.title: Preemptions per second
panels.description: The engine evicted running requests to free KV cache and will recompute them.

panels.title: Quality verdict by deployment
panels.description: Answer-quality verdict of the latest Release Guard evaluation. UNKNOWN is a stored verdict (no comparable evidence). An empty row means never evaluated or the policy does not gate on quality.

panels.title: Guard decision by deployment
panels.description: Promotion decision of the latest evaluation. WAIT means not enough trustworthy evidence yet.

panels.title: Endpoint guard decision
panels.description: Endpoint Release Guard on a candidate serving plan, for example each step of a staged switch from a closed API.

panels.title: Configured traffic share by binding
panels.description: Share of new requests the active serving plan sends to each binding. A weighted plan is a canary. Fallback traffic after a failure is not included.

panels.title: Post-promotion observation
panels.description: After a promotion with automatic rollback, Release Guard watches the promoted revision and restores the retained one on a regression.

panels.title: Rollbacks
panels.description: automatic: Release Guard observation restored the retained revision. operator: someone ran rollout rollback.

panels.title: Latest run outcome by endpoint
panels.description: From the report of the latest optimization run that targeted each endpoint.

targets.expr:
max by (endpoint) (
  (infercrane_campaign_outcome{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",outcome="winner_selected"} * 1)
  or (infercrane_campaign_outcome{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",outcome="baseline_kept"} * 2)
  or (infercrane_campaign_outcome{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",outcome="no_winner"} * 3)
  or (infercrane_campaign_outcome{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",outcome="in_progress"} * 4)
  or (infercrane_campaign_outcome{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",outcome="cancelled"} * 5)
)

panels.title: Cost per 1M output tokens (latest run)
panels.description: Measured by the latest run on its benchmark, with the sourced GPU price. A setup without a price or a measured throughput is unknown.

panels.title: Cost change, chosen vs baseline
panels.description: Negative is a saving. Unknown unless both costs are known.

targets.expr:
max by (endpoint) (
  (infercrane_campaign_state{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",state="awaiting_approval"} * 1)
  or (infercrane_campaign_state{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",state="approved"} * 2)
  or (infercrane_campaign_state{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",state="running"} * 3)
  or (infercrane_campaign_state{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",state="ranked"} * 4)
  or (infercrane_campaign_state{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",state="qualified"} * 5)
  or (infercrane_campaign_state{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",state="guard_passed"} * 6)
  or (infercrane_campaign_state{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",state="rejected"} * 7)
  or (infercrane_campaign_state{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",state="inconclusive"} * 8)
  or (infercrane_campaign_state{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",state="promoted"} * 9)
  or (infercrane_campaign_state{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",state="observed"} * 10)
  or (infercrane_campaign_state{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",state="cancelled"} * 11)
  or (infercrane_campaign_state{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",state="failed"} * 12)
  or (infercrane_campaign_state{job=~"$results_job",endpoint=~"$endpoint",state="cleaned"} * 13)
)
